description: This file defines the interface 'Delegator' which provides a comprehensive API for managing entity objects in the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting entities, as well as cache management, sequence generation, and relationship handling. It serves as a core component for data access and persistence in the project.
